name: segmentation-flood
description: Machine-vision read of a slotted subject: translucent accent segmentation masks flood on in quantized scanline steps, each region gets a thin bracket and mono label chip, a deterministic 2-frame HUD flicker rides the pass, then the labeled read settles clean.

vars.description: Comma-separated region labels; 2 to 4 are used, one translucent mask + bracket + mono chip each.
Seconds from mount start when the segmentation pass begins. Clamped so the pass and any exit stay inside the clip.
Deterministic 2-frame HUD luminance toggle riding the flood pass.
Mask, bracket, and chip color: green rides --brand, blue rides --accent, violet rides --accent-2.
Optional departure. Default none: the labeled read holds until the frame cuts.
